description: This file provides stub functions that redirect gettext-related calls to the GNU libintl library, facilitating compatibility and additional features like logging on glibc systems.

methods.name: gettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_gettext, providing gettext functionality.

methods.name: dgettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dgettext, providing domain-specific gettext.

methods.name: dcgettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dcgettext, providing category-specific gettext.

methods.name: ngettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_ngettext, providing plural-aware gettext.

methods.name: dngettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dngettext, providing domain-specific plural gettext.

methods.name: dcngettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dcngettext, providing category-specific plural gettext.

methods.name: textdomain
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_textdomain, setting the text domain.

methods.name: bindtextdomain
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_bindtextdomain, binding a text domain to a directory.

methods.name: bind_textdomain_codeset
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_bind_textdomain_codeset, setting the codeset for a domain.
